from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyOperatingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Captures the operating cash inflow metric reported in a single company's financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the report")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 2024 年第一季度)")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific label of the cash flow line item")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount as a numeric value")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., 元，CNY)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_records: list[CompanyOperatingCashFlow]
